{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check sample_seq per patient_id
sample_seq_max = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
df_max_seq = df[df['sample_seq'] == df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].transform('max')]

print(f"Rows after deduplication (keeping highest sample_seq per patient): {len(df_max_seq)}")

# Verify the number of re-tested patients
n_retested = len(df) - len(df_max_seq)
print(f"Number of re-tested patients (duplicated patient_id): {n_retested}")"}
